page_title: PSG 3-1 LEN | PSG v Lens 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 3 - 1 Goal! Florian Sotoca plays it to Morgan Guilavogui (Lens), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Gianluigi Donnarumma. 3:1.
90+3' A cross from a corner kick by Lens is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

90+3' Elye Wahi (Lens) drives a shot towards the roof of the net from inside the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 3 - 0 Goal! Fabian Ruiz plays it to Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Brice Samba. 3:0.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Wonderful movement by Paris SG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
87' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Jonathan Gradit (Lens) for a tough tackle.
86' Substitution. Carlos Soler (Paris SG) on for Warren Zaire-Emery.
83' The substitution has been made. Danilo Pereira (Paris SG) has replaced Lucas Hernandez.
83' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. David Costa (Lens) replaces Andy Diouf.
82' Deiver Machado (Lens) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francois Letexier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
80' Vitinha (Paris SG) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ousmane Dembele will be replaced by Fabian Ruiz (Paris SG).
79' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Stijn Spierings (Lens), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
76' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.

75' Marco Asensio (Paris SG) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
74' Here's the change. Angelo Fulgini leaves the pitch and Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) comes on as a substitute.
74' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
73' Dangerous play by Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG). Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Lens.
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

68' Paris SG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
66' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) takes it short.
65' Vitinha (Paris SG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Paris SG.
65' Paris SG take a short corner kick.

65' Brice Samba was forced into action to thwart Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball is out of play and Paris SG manage to earn a corner.
60' Marco Asensio (Paris SG) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Wonderful movement by Paris SG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Adrien Thomasson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Elye Wahi (Lens).
56' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
52' 2 - 0 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 2:0.
51' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
50' Lens fail to score from a corner as Gianluigi Donnarumma (Paris SG) leaps to collect the ball.
49' The referee blows his whistle as Deiver Machado (Lens) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Franck Haise has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Julien Le Cardinal (Lens) comes on the pitch for Przemyslaw Frankowski.
46' Half-time substitution. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) will not participate anymore and Stijn Spierings is coming on.
46' The whistle blows and Francois Letexier starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+3' Paris SG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Warren Zaire-Emery passes the ball to Marco Asensio (Paris SG) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Brice Samba couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
43' Florian Sotoca (Lens) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) is able to continue to play.
42' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
42' Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florian Sotoca (Lens) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
39' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) picks up an injury.
37' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Andy Diouf (Lens) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
36' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
35' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and it's Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
33' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

33' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) swings in a cross from the corner, but Brice Samba reads it well and gathers the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Paris SG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' The corner is swung in but Paris SG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Referee Francois Letexier halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Franck Haise, then shows him a yellow.
31' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Paris SG force their opponents to concede a corner.
30' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Brice Samba is alert and denies him with a nice save.
30' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lens, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Lens will take a free kick.
25' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
23' Deiver Machado (Lens) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francois Letexier saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Paris SG in a dangerous position.
19' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Facundo Medina (Lens) for his blatant foul.
18' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
17' Francois Letexier blows for a foul after Lucas Hernandez (Paris SG) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Free kick. Lens will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
15' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Paris SG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
8' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) works the corner short.
8' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) makes a strong challenge and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
5' Warren Zaire-Emery (Paris SG) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Paris SG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Paris SG will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francois Letexier.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
